caption: The drawing depicts a three-piece historical men's suit consisting of a long red coat, an ornate cream-colored waistcoat, and matching cream-colored breeches. The red coat features long sleeves, a turned-down collar, decorative buttons along the front, and cuffs adorned with lace trim. The waistcoat underneath is cream with gold embroidery and floral detailing, also featuring buttons and pockets with elaborate trim. The breeches are loose-fitting, extending to just below the knee, and have button detailing at the hem. To the right of the main colored illustration, there is a secondary, smaller, uncolored outline sketch showing the rear view of the same outfit, displaying the coat's rear vent and pocket flaps. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects present.
title: Man's Coat and Waistcoat
